option_relations.rationale: Arrhythmogenic syncope due to multivessel coronary artery disease is a specific type of arrhythmogenic disorder and ischemic heart disease.
Acute myocardial ischemia-induced syncope is a type of ischemic heart disease.
Ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease is a broader category that includes various types of ischemic heart diseases.
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) with Giant R-wave Syndrome is not directly related to the provided options and leaves.
